item.title: Microsoft is even gobbling up PC resources on Linux — Visual Studio Code could be hogging hard drive space
item.description: VS Code's official Snap package on Linux has a bug first reported in 2024 that still hasn't been fixed and is gobbling up storage space.

item.title: Edge Canary's Read Aloud tool now opens Copilot Vision instead of reading text — a surprising change that could frustrate accessibility-focused users
item.description: Microsoft's experimental Edge Canary build has some changes for the Read Aloud function. Instead of reading the text on the page, it now launches Copilot Vision instead.

item.title: Ready your COD Points — Call of Duty reveals Black Ops 7 Season 2 Battle Pass content
item.description: As Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 fans gear up for Season 2, Treyarch drops details on the new battle pass, revealing operator skins for the new villain, Victoria Atwood, along with new weapon blueprints.

item.title: Overwatch 2 drops the 2 with a colossal overhaul — the Reign of Talon begins with 5 new characters dropping next week and a freakin' Hello Kitty collab
item.description: Blizzard's new Overwatch Spotlight presentation revealed that Overwatch 2 is dropping the 2, and now has a completely new live-service structure.

item.title: Lost on Diablo 4’s story? This recap gets you ready for Lord of Hatred
item.description: Here's a rundown of all the events leading to Diablo 4's newest expansion, Lord of Hatred.

item.title: Epic wants to bring its store to the next-gen Xbox — and begins to show serious growth. "We've been talking to the folks at Microsoft."
item.description: We recently caught up with Epic Games Store VP and GM Steve Allison to learn about how the platform is going in a world increasingly dominated by Steam.

item.title: NVIDIA points finger at Windows update — Microsoft patch blamed for PC gaming issues
item.description: NVIDIA is investigating widespread PC gaming issues that appear to be linked to a January Windows update. Users report performance drops and graphical problems, with uninstalling KB5074109 offering temporary relief.

item.title: Rumor suggests Final Fantasy 7 Remake Part 3 should hit Xbox on day one — shedding PlayStation exclusivity completely
item.description: A new rumor suggests that when Final Fantasy 7 Remake Part 3 launches, it will be available on Xbox, PC, and Switch 2 alongside PS5 on day one.

item.title: Forza Horizon 6 is getting full cross-save across PC and console for the first time — even on PS5
item.description: Playground Games confirms that Forza Horizon 6 will support cross-platform play, including cross-saves, between PC, Xbox, and PlayStation consoles.

item.title: Helldivers 2's new Bastion tank absolutely rules — it's amazing and awful all at once, and my new favorite stratagem for spilling Automaton oil
item.description: I've put Helldivers 2's new Bastion tank through its paces, and am happy to confirm: it's absolutely awesome.
